# Added combat and station assets

- **Space Station Kit**, Kenney. Selected GLB models in `space_station/`.
  Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/space-station-kit
  License: CC0. The pack license is in `space_station/License.txt`.
- **Sci-Fi Essentials Kit**, Quaternius. The zombie gunner uses its rifle model. Three earlier robot models remain in `sci_fi_essentials/` but are not spawned.
  Source: https://opengameart.org/content/sci-fi-essentials-kit
  License: CC0.
- **Animated Mech Pack**, Quaternius. Four imported FBX mechs remain in `animated_mechs/` but are not spawned.
  Source: https://opengameart.org/content/animated-mech-pack
  License: CC0. The pack license is in `animated_mechs/License.txt`.

The melee swing sound in `audio/third_party/knife_swing.wav` was synthesized for this project.

The active enemies use the original undead model in `enemies/undead.tscn`. The Zombie Apocalypse Kit files in `zombie_apocalypse/` were evaluated as alternatives but are not used in the active enemy roster. Source: https://quaternius.com/packs/zombieapocalypsekit.html (CC0).
